name: word-roller-glitch
title: Word Roller Glitch
description: A heavy uppercase word swaps with an RGB-split glitch: for eight frames a blue top half and a rose bottom half jitter sideways behind the word, then it holds clean until the next swap.
useWhen: Short, punchy uppercase words (hack, code, ship, win) swapped on a dark title.
A cut between words that should read as a signal fault.
avoidWhen: The tone is soft or premium: use word-roller-blur.
Only one word glitches in once: use rgb-glitch-text or sustained-glitch.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas. The last one is where it settles.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the word in pixels. A wide word shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Glitch top
variables.description: Color of the top half layer during a glitch.

variables.label: Glitch bottom
variables.description: Color of the bottom half layer during a glitch.

variables.label: Frames per word
variables.description: How long each word is shown, in 30 fps frames.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
